newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 5.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT, the Communications and Transportation Ministry said in a daily update.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Light rains along the coast of southern Baja California, Sonora, Sinaloa, Michoacan and Guerrero states. Winds from the north and northeast of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour) and waves as high as three to five feet.
Tropical winds showering light rains along coast of Tamaulipas and northern Veracruz. Winds from east and northeast at 10 to 15 knots.

Cold front approaching the southeast Gulf and expected to hit northern Tamaulipas later today bringing light rains and wind speeds of 10 to 20 knots (19 to 37 kilometers/11 to 22 miles per hour) and wave heights of between four and six feet.
Tropical winds carrying light rains over the coast of Quintana Roo state. Winds from the northeast at 10 to 15 knots with waves three to five feet high.
